description: This 100W fast charging wall charger adapter is a premium and high-speed charging solution designed for OnePlus smartphones and all USB-C enabled devices. It supports Warp Charge and Dash Charge technology, ensuring ultra-fast and efficient charging performance so your device powers up in minimal time. Built with a compact, lightweight, and travel-friendly design, this charger is perfect for both home and on-the-go use. It comes with a high-quality USB Type-C cable that delivers stable, safe, and fast power output without interruption. This charger is compatible with OnePlus 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13 series and Nord/CE models, along with other Android smartphones including Samsung, Xiaomi, Realme, Oppo, and more USB-C supported devices. For complete device safety, it includes advanced protection features such as over-voltage protection, over-current protection, short-circuit protection, and temperature control, ensuring safe and reliable charging every time. If you are looking for a powerful, durable, and super-fast charging adapter, this 100W charger is the perfect choice for daily use, travel, and heavy usage.
